tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// zab lam nā ro'i chos drug gi bka' bab nyams dang rtogs pa byin rlabs kyi bla

ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dad pa'i lang tsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rigs drug bdag nyid zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang*// byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen zhabs// 'phags mchog dam pa klu sgrub 'gro ba'i gnyen// grub pa'i dbang phyug ma taṃ gi la sogs// rim pa lnga dang grong 'jug 'pho ba yi// bka' bab brgyud pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin lag na rdo rje 'chang*// grub chen rgyal po dpal ldan sa ra ha// 'khor lo sdom pa mchog grub lū hi pa// zung 'jug don rtogs ḍiṅgi pa la sogs// phyag rgya chen po 'khor 'das dbyer med pa'i// bkab bab brgyud pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs| |gang gis de nyid mngon gyur su ma ti// kun tu bzang mo bden gnyis mthar son dang*// 'khrul ba rtsad bcad thang lo pa yi mtshan// ye shes don gzigs kar+ṇa ri pa sogs// gtum mo dga' bde'i rdzogs rim lam gyi mchog /bka' bab brgyud pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rnal 'byor dbang phyug ḍoṃ bhi he ru kaḥ /bde chen mchog brnyes grub chen bi na sa// 'khor 'das dbyer med don gzigs lwa ba pa// 'khor sgyur in+d+ra bhū ti chung ba sogs// 'od gsal rmi lam sgyu ma'i lam bzang gi// bka' bab brgyud pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar bka' bab nyams kyi brgyud pa bzhi'i// smin grol lam bzang gcig tu bsdoms pa yi// rtogs pa byin rlabs don brgyud til+li par// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// lus srog gces 'dzin btang ba'i dam bca' yis// bka' ba bcu gnyis srog dang bsdos byas te// bla ma'i man ngag thob mdzad nā ro par// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// sngon sbyangs las kyis sgra sgyur bdag por gyur// 'phags yul bgrod nas dam pa mchog dang mjal// snyan brgyud gdams pa'i mnga' bdag lho brag par// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// dka' ba dpag med sgrub pa'i brtul zhugs 'chang*// dharma ma ti'i gdams mchog mngon sum du// bsgoms pas tshe 'dir mchog grub mi la rjer| |gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// gang gis de nyid shes bya'i rang gshis rnams// mi la'i drin las skad cig gis gzigs nas// gangs can nges don bdag po sgam po par// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// thub bstan sgor zhugs sgom tshe 'khrul shes kyi// mthong lam ngo sprad slar yang snyi sgom gyi// nges don gdams pas rang grol rdo rje rgyal// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// klu zhabs nyid sprul ston pa'i rgyal tshab mchog

/rgyal ba'i bstan la rgyal ba gnyis par grags// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mgon po 'bri gung par// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// gnas lugs rtogs pa mchog brnyes bsod nams grags// til+li'i rnam sprul rdo rje grags pa'i zhabs// phyag na pad+mo'i rnam 'khrul thog kha bar// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// 'gro ba'i ded dpon grags pa bsod nams zhabs// sa ra ha dngos rdo rje rin chen dang*// pad+ma'i rnam 'phrul rdo rje rgyal po la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// bstan pa'i mnga' bdag 'dzam gling chos kyi rgyal| |bshes gnyen dam pa don grub rgyal po dang*// gdams pa'i brgyud 'dzin nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// 'dul ba 'dzin pa ngag dbang rgyal mtshan zhabs// bstan pa'i gsal byed ngag gi dbang po dang*// 'jam dbyangs rnam sprul rin chen chos kyi rgyal// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// rgyal ba'i dbang po kun dga' rat+na'i mtshan// rig 'dzin chen po sna tshogs rang grol dang*// man ngag mdzod 'dzin dpal gyi rgya mtsho la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// snyigs dus 'dren mchog dharma rā dza'i zhabs// rdo rje 'chang dngos mkhan chen rnam 'joms mtshan// rang sems mngon gyur chos kyi grags pa la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// don gnyis mchog stsol yi dam 'khor lo sdom// rgyal ba kun yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// bar chad srung mdzad chos skyong srung ma la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// de ltar gus pas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// bdag sogs 'gro rnams 'di nas byang chub bar// skyon med dal 'byor mchog thob bstan dang mjal// rdo rje slob dpon mchog gi rjes 'dzin cing*// long med mi rtag 'chi ba rgyud la dran// bslu med rgyu 'bras blang dor tshul shes shing*// so byang sdom pas shes rgyud legs sbyangs nas// rten 'brel rmad byung smin lam dbang thob ste// sku bzhi ye shes rnam lnga'i bag chags thob// mchog gsum skyabs song sgrib sbyong lam 'bad cing*// tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs bla ma'i sku mchog las| |ting 'dzin dbang gis rgyud smin mchog thob nas// mtshan nyid kun ldan snang phyogs bskyed pa'i rim// stong phyogs gzung 'dzin gnyis stong lam bsgom zhing*// gsang ba'i gnad bskul bzlas pa mthar phyin nas// rdo rje'i lus la zab mo'i rten 'brel gnad// rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi ldan sbyor ba can// srog rtsol gtum mo'i lam la rab 'bad pas// bde stong lhan skyes ye shes rtogs pa dang*// spyi dang sbas don 'od gsal gnyid 'thug gi// chos sku rang byung ye shes myur rtogs shing*// chos kun rmi lam nyid rtogs sprul sgyur la// rang dbang thob pas ye shes mchog grub cing*// gang yang sgyu ma'i rol par rtag shar bas// sku lnga ye shes rnam lnga'i don rtogs nas// gnas skabs bar do'i gdams pa mthar phyin zhing*// bsu skyel 'pho ba'i gdams pas mtshams sbyar nas// rang don chos sku mngon gyur rang rig gshis// bzo med don mthong gdan sar snyeg pa dang*// de yi rang mdangs yan lag bdun ldan pa'i// longs skus dag pa'i 'gro rnams sgrol ba dang*// las kyis mnar ba'i rigs drug 'gro blo'i ngor// gang 'dul sna tshogs sprul sku'i sgyu 'phrul gyis| |ji zla ji bzhin 'gro ba'i don byed shog

/skye ba kun tu sogs brjod/ de ltar lam zab mo nā ro'i chos drug gi bka' bab nyams kyi brgyud pa'i shing rta'i srol chen po bzhi dang*/ de nyid gcig tu bsdoms pa rtogs pa don gyi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ lam gyi rim pa tshang la go ma log pa bsgom zhing mthar phyin pa'i 'dod gsol smon lam dang bcas pa 'di'ang*/ 'phyongs rgyas dpal ri ba grags pa dbang pos bskul ba'i ngor/ 'bri gung pa rdo rje 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes/ me byi tha skar zla ba'i nyer gnyis la bye ri stag rnam par rtse ba'i gzhal med khang chen po'i re'u mig kun gsal gsang ba sngags kyi pho brang du mgyogs par bris pas bdag gzhan thams cad lam 'dis smin cing grol nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang dam pa thob par gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ bhawan+tu//
